title: Thread Across the Threshold
description: Your boot catches on something at ankle height. You stop. In the dark ahead, a thin cord runs taut between two iron wall-hooks — nearly invisible, angled to catch a moving foot. Whatever it connects to deeper in the shadows has not yet moved. You are still in the moment before.

choices.label: Step back slowly and step over
choices.description: Retreat one careful inch at a time, then clear it cleanly.

success.narrative: You lift your foot free without disturbing the cord and step over it.

failure.narrative: Your heel clips the wire on the way back — a crack of sound, and then a heavy wooden beam swings from the dark above and catches your shoulder.

choices.label: Trace the cord to find its trigger
choices.description: Follow the wire by touch in both directions before moving.

success.narrative: Your fingers find the anchor-point and you work the cord loose from its hook without springing it.

failure.narrative: Your probing hand pulls the wrong way and the mechanism releases — a spray of iron tacks from a box above, several finding your forearm.

choices.label: Trigger it deliberately from distance
choices.description: Step back and throw something heavy at the cord.

success.narrative: The thrown object catches the wire true and the beam swings harmlessly through the empty air ahead of you.

failure.narrative: The object misses, and you lean forward to see where it landed — into the cord, with your face.

visual.alt_text: A low dark corridor, a nearly invisible thread strung across the passage at ankle height. Iron hooks hold the cord taut against stone walls slick with damp.
